title: G-CAST: Governed Continual Self-Training for E-Commerce Agents under Evolving Demands
abstract: arXiv:2611.17814v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With the rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs), an increasing number of users are turning to LLM-powered agents for conversational shopping in e-commerce. However, the user needs continue to change as new product categories, procurement scenarios, and feature requests emerge. At the same time, the product's execution harness-including its tools, skills, and operating procedures-continues to evolve to support increasingly sophisticated interactions. These changes create two practical challenges: 1) Demand drift alters the distribution, intent, and complexity of user requests, causing a model trained once to fall behind; 2) Harness evolution requires the model to use newly introduced capabilities correctly without losing behavior that users already rely on. translated_title: G-CAST：面向电商智能体在需求持续演变下的受治理持续自训练
translated_abstract: 随着大型语言模型（LLM）的快速发展，越来越多的用户开始借助LLM驱动的智能体进行电商对话式购物。然而，随着新商品品类、采购场景和功能需求的不断涌现，用户需求也在持续变化。与此同时，产品的执行框架（包括其工具、技能和操作流程）也在不断演进，以支持日益复杂的交互。这些变化带来了两个实际挑战：1）需求漂移改变了用户请求的分布、意图和复杂度，使一次性训练的模型逐渐落后；2）框架演进要求模型正确使用新引入的能力，同时不丢失用户已依赖的既有行为。在这种场景下，周期性的人工再训练过于滞后且耗费人力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了G-CAST，一个受治理的持续自训练系统……（原文摘要到此截断）
tldr: G-CAST提出了一套受治理的持续自训练系统，使电商LLM智能体能够在用户需求漂移和执行框架不断演进的条件下自动持续适应，从而摆脱滞后且高成本的人工周期性再训练。
en_tdlr: G-CAST is a governed continual self-training system that enables e-commerce LLM agents to continuously adapt to demand drift and harness evolution without relying on delayed and labor-intensive periodic manual retraining.
